name: Squall line, 250 m
line: The line at 250 m: single storm cells and waves along the gust front.
note: Its random starting noise comes from GM1's own random numbers, so the details differ from CM1's as they would with another seed.

changes.why: the same 300 km length at 250 m
the same 60 km width at 250 m
80 levels of 250 m: the same 20 km depth at twice the vertical detail (CM1's file has 40 of 500 m)
the time step scaled with the grid spacing, as CM1 advises (6 s at 1 km)
netCDF, which ncview, xarray and most tools read (CM1's file asks for GrADS)
one file per saved time, so each picture has its own file
